description: This file defines a React hook `useLocalStorage` that manages persistent state synchronized with localStorage, including features like versioned schema support, migration, debounced persistence, and serialization customization. It also provides a helper function to persist reducer state.

methods.name: useLocalStorage( key, initialValue, { version = 1, migrate, serialize = JSON.stringify, deserialize = JSON.parse, debounceMs = 300 } = {} )
methods.description: A React hook that maintains a piece of state synchronized with localStorage, supporting versioning, migration, serialization, and debouncing.

methods.name: persistReducerState(dispatch, state)
methods.description: A helper function to dispatch a persistence action for a reducer-based state management, enabling explicit persistence triggers.
